question: Does restoring training-only native monthly background detail improve the frozen spectral anomaly forecast on unchanged native observation domains?
reason_for_new_contract: The completed three-frame memory experiment did not reach its predeclared 2 percent validation switch threshold in any channel; all selected forecasts remained incumbent. This new finite attempt repairs separately identified seasonal representation error; it does not loosen that threshold, change memory parameters or repeat the same search.
method: For identity channels: native monthly arithmetic training mean plus unchanged learned L12 anomaly. For positive humidity: native monthly arithmetic training mean times exp(predicted log field minus spectral log climatology). Background fitted from 1979-2014 only. Native pressure masks and training domains preserved.
background_domain: Per-variable native grid. Calendar-month means use only finite, training-fixed valid cells and per-month pressure screening. Means computed over observed samples only; no zero-filled missing values.
selection: No hyperparameter search. For each whole channel choose corrected forecast if its full native PHYSICAL validation MSE averaged over six leads is at least 2 percent below incumbent; otherwise keep incumbent. Do not select the native seasonal comparator. Freeze choices before development evaluation.
normalizers: Frozen original L6 TRAINING physical seasonal error per channel from the archived L12 report; equal channel and lead weight. Humidity scored in kg/kg.
output: Use exact saved L12 spectral anomaly at the existing 1.25-degree grid; bilinear periodic-longitude interpolation of trained background and nearest fixed native mask. Coarse 2.5-degree download is exact subset; original L6 remains independent and unchanged. Interpolated background adds no new observations or claimed local skill. Bilinear background interpolation renormalizes finite-neighbor weights; zero filling is not treated as an observation.

promotion_gate.additional: Finite forecast, positive humidity, chronological isolation, exact saved-model replay, no Xue quantization clamping; otherwise publish clearly marked research candidate without making it default. Gate cannot change selected parameters.

regional_diagnostic: Same three fixed 9x9 native patches and leads 1 and 6 as Research 0229, reported only after selection; no regional fitting.
source_authenticity_reservation: The user questions the whole data chain. Source integrity and reproduced calculations do not establish physical truth; no independent source replication is performed.
protected: Original L6/L12 forecasts, data pointers and public bytes retained
No testing-interval refit, weight tuning or hidden retry
Data authenticity of the whole pipeline remains unverified; no independent source replication
Historical origin and monthly cadence visible on website; no typhoon or ENSO attribution
External dependencies and source observations not copied into Adva
Native authority, paused Lorentzian work and library obligations unchanged
No recasting the failed memory switch as successful dynamics learning
No 2026 observed data used in correction
Retain frozen source and model bytes

budget.enforcement: Supervised finite channel loops, worker CPU/address-space limits, parent timeout and persistent private launch ledger. No automatic retry.

authorship: Codex (OpenAI), Unknown v0.3 through Mingli Yuan account proxy only; not his review or endorsement.
scope: Retrospective historical-origin monthly forecast revision. Training-only representation correction, not a newly learned dynamical memory benefit or higher-frequency forecast.
